algorithm.summary: EndpointId = base58btc(00 24 08 01 12 20 || ed25519_public_key), the libp2p PeerId derivation. `derive-*` vectors map a public key to the id (`expected_endpoint_id`); `verdict-*` vectors say whether a text is a canonical derived id (`valid`): it must base58btc-decode to exactly those 38 bytes and re-encode to itself.

WARNING: TEST-ONLY KEY MATERIAL. Every seed here is public and fixed; none is, or may ever be, a real identity key.

vectors.description: Ed25519 public key from the stated TEST-ONLY seed; the id is the PeerId derivation of that key.
